import { invalidInput, ok } from '@omne-harness-lite/identity-values';
const RFC3339 = /^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})[Tt]([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2})(?:\.([0-9]+))?([Zz]|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})$/;
export function instantFromEpochMs(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(value)) {
        return invalidInput('Instant: not an integer millisecond value');
    }
    return ok(value);
}
/** 解析 RFC 3339 时间点；日期（无时刻）与无偏移的串一律拒绝，与 Schema 的 pattern 一致。 */
export function instantFromRfc3339(value) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string')
        return invalidInput('Instant: not a string');
    const match = RFC3339.exec(value);
    if (match === null)
        return invalidInput('Instant: not an RFC 3339 date-time');
    const [, y, mo, d, h, mi, s, frac, offset] = match;
    const millis = frac === undefined ? 0 : Number(`0.${frac}`) * 1000;
    const base = Date.UTC(Number(y), Number(mo) - 1, Number(d), Number(h), Number(mi), Number(s));
    if (Number.isNaN(base))
        return invalidInput('Instant: invalid calendar value');
    // 拒绝 Date.UTC 会静默进位的值（如 2026-02-30）。
    const check = new Date(base);
    if (check.getUTCFullYear() !== Number(y) ||
        check.getUTCMonth() !== Number(mo) - 1 ||
        check.getUTCDate() !== Number(d) ||
        check.getUTCHours() !== Number(h) ||
        check.getUTCMinutes() !== Number(mi) ||
        check.getUTCSeconds() !== Number(s)) {
        return invalidInput('Instant: invalid calendar value');
    }
    let offsetMs = 0;
    if (offset !== 'Z' && offset !== 'z') {
        const sign = offset.startsWith('-') ? -1 : 1;
        const [oh, om] = offset.slice(1).split(':');
        if (Number(oh) > 23 || Number(om) > 59)
            return invalidInput('Instant: invalid offset');
        offsetMs = sign * (Number(oh) * 60 + Number(om)) * 60_000;
    }
    return ok(Math.round(base + millis - offsetMs));
}
/** 规范书写：UTC，毫秒精度，`Z` 结尾。 */
export function instantToRfc3339(instant) {
    return new Date(instant).toISOString();
}
export function compareInstants(a, b) {
    return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
}
export function addDuration(instant, duration) {
    return (instant + duration);
}
const ISO_DURATION = /^P(?:(\d+)W|(?:(\d+)D)?(?:T(?:(\d+)H)?(?:(\d+)M)?(?:(\d+)S)?)?)$/;
/**
 * S-14 的 `offer_ttl` 解析：正整数毫秒，或 ISO 8601 时长（`P7D`、`PT1H30M`、`P2W`；不含年月，因为不定长）。
 * 非正、非有限、不合形状 ⇒ `invalidInput`。缺席（`undefined`）不进解析器——由调用方分流到默认值。
 */
export function parseOfferTtl(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'number') {
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value <= 0) {
            return invalidInput('offer_ttl: must be a positive integer number of milliseconds');
        }
        return ok(value);
    }
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
        const match = ISO_DURATION.exec(value);
        if (match === null || value === 'P' || value.endsWith('T')) {
            return invalidInput('offer_ttl: not an ISO 8601 duration');
        }
        const [, weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds] = match;
        const total = Number(weeks ?? 0) * 7 * 86_400_000 +
            Number(days ?? 0) * 86_400_000 +
            Number(hours ?? 0) * 3_600_000 +
            Number(minutes ?? 0) * 60_000 +
            Number(seconds ?? 0) * 1000;
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total <= 0) {
            return invalidInput('offer_ttl: must be positive');
        }
        return ok(total);
    }
    return invalidInput('offer_ttl: not a number or ISO 8601 duration');
}
